# OpenCL C headers (minimal vendor)

Only the files required by `#include <CL/cl.h>`:

- `CL/cl.h`
- `CL/cl_platform.h`
- `CL/cl_version.h`

Upstream: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenCL-Headers  
License: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE`)

To refresh from upstream:

```powershell
# clone / copy CL/cl.h CL/cl_platform.h CL/cl_version.h + LICENSE into this folder
```
